get_state_locobot: get the current robot state as x, y, yaw coordinates from the Habitat simulator agent
go_to_relative_locobot: move the robot to a goal state relative to its initial pose using xyt_position
go_to_absolute_locobot: move the robot to an absolute world frame position using x, y, yaw coordinates
obstacle_check_locobot: check if an obstacle is in front of the robot by calling the parent sensor
act_locobot: execute a continuous or discrete actuation action like turn_left, turn_right, or move_forward
